description:
Why Does Ice Float? Water's Superpower Mystery! — Drop a rock into a pond, and it sinks to the bottom. But toss a giant frozen iceberg in, and it bobs right on top! Why?
Kids science answer for "why does ice float kids science cartoon" with fun 2D animation by BabyBeats Rhymo!

Most liquids shrink and sink when frozen, but water molecules form a honeycomb crystal lattice that expands, making ice lighter than liquid water!

BabyBeats Rhymo creates kid-safe 2D science cartoons and funny educational stories every day for curious US kids and families!
